'''''Glandora prostrata''''', the '''shrubby gromwell''', '''creeping gromwell''' or '''purple gromwell''' (names it shares with ''[[Lithospermum purpurocaeruleum]]'' and ''[[Glandora diffusa]]''), is a species of ''[[Glandora]]'' native to Portugal, Spain and France.<ref name="77088633-1" >{{cite web |url=https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:77088633-1 |title=''Glandora prostrata'' Regel |author=<!--Not stated--> |date=2017 |website=Plants of the World Online |publisher=Board of Trustees of the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew |access-date=6 September 2020 }}</ref> Its cultivars 'Grace Ward' and 'Heavenly Blue' have gained the [[Royal Horticultural Society]]'s [[Award of Garden Merit]].<ref>{{cite web|title= ''Glandora prostrata'' 'Grace Ward' gromwell 'Grace Ward' |url=https://www.rhs.org.uk/Plants/386795/Glandora-prostrata-Grace-Ward/Details |publisher=The Royal Horticultural Society |accessdate=6 September 2020 }}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title= ''Glandora prostrata'' 'Heavenly Blue' gromwell 'Heavenly Blue' |url=https://www.rhs.org.uk/Plants/386799/Glandora-prostrata-Heavenly-Blue/Details |publisher=The Royal Horticultural Society |accessdate=6 September 2020 }}</ref>

==Subspecies==
A subspecies is currently accepted:<ref name = "77088633-1" />

*''Glandora prostrata'' subsp. ''lusitanica'' <small>(Samp.) D.C.Thomas</small>
